title: Lost task-log lines came from a plain git merge in the main tree; now blocked

owner_note.text: I made the git-guard hook refuse git merge, pull, rebase and autostash in the main checkout (merge --abort and the merge-base/tree/file commands stay open), and merge.mjs now lands every branch by three-way write instead of git merge. The alternative, a warning only, would not have stopped the 17:38 incident. Any agent whose brief says to run git merge in main now gets a block that points to `node Server/merge.mjs <worktree dir>`.
